visual.general_description: Four grayscale radiographs labeled A to D with white measurement lines and printed angle and distance labels.
visual.detailed_description: Four side-by-side grayscale radiograph panels with panel letters A to D at the top left of each. Panel A is a frontal view of a knee with a long white line through the femur and tibia and two short crossing lines at the joint, labeled 188°. Panel B is a side view of a knee with white lines labeled AP and AT and an arc labeled 14°. Panel C is a full-length frontal view from pelvis to feet with a white line from a point labeled S at each hip bone to a point labeled M at each ankle, with 84.3cm printed on the left of the image and 87.5cm on the right. Panel D is a frontal view of one limb with a long white line, two short parallel lines near the knee and labels 85° and 68°.

No other text is visible.

A horizontal white line near the top of the tibia and a vertical white line down the tibia form an arc labeled 88°. The panel letter A is printed at the top left.
